loading_and_error_states.skeletons: Utiliser des éléments <Skeleton className='h-12 w-full rounded-xl animate-pulse bg-muted' /> pour chaque widget et tableau pendant le chargement.
loading_and_error_states.error_messages: Les erreurs doivent présenter une illustration/icône d'alerte bienveillante, un titre compréhensible en français et un bouton 'Réessayer' à fort contraste (data-testid='error-retry-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive and key informational element MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='client-bottom-nav-parcels', data-testid='install-pwa-btn', data-testid='theme-toggle-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.react_file_extension: This project uses .js and .jsx files. Do not use TypeScript .tsx extensions when creating or editing code files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header backgrounds or dropdown overlays. Always include backdrop-blur or solid bg-surface.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Use generous padding and rounded corners (rounded-2xl) to project a modern, reassuring logistics experience.
